text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — planning to freeze canary config for v3.8 tonight at 02:00 UTC. Need release notes finalised, embedding-service pin approved, and a smoke checklist. Posting a short runbook below. :eyes:

Maya Patel: Runbook snippet:
```
- Freeze canary config @ 02:00 UTC
- Pin embedding-service -> 3.8.2-quant by 01:30 UTC
- Run smoke: /scripts/smoke_v3.sh --canary
- Rollback window: 30m immediate, escalate to 2h fallback
- Notify oncall if >5% error spike
```

Josh Klein: Rollback window sounds tight. Who's owning quick rollback? :thinking_face:

Maya Patel: Josh Klein owns rollback lane tonight unless you're paging someone else. I'll own release notes verification and docs tags.

Priya Nair: I'll finish the release notes and run the docs lint by 00:40 UTC. Will post the final changelog link here.

Anika Rao: Ops note — I'll pin embedding-service to 3.8.2-quant in deploy-bot staging and prod pin by 01:30 UTC. Will comment with the pin ID. :thumbsup:

Leo Martins: Can we add a quick pre-freeze traffic drain for 5m? I can set the traffic-weight to 0.1 for canary before freezing.

Maya Patel: Yes please. Drain 5m then freeze. Add 'no new canary traffic' tag after pin.

Deploy-bot: scheduled_canary_deploy v3.8 canary queued for 02:05 UTC (pre-freeze checks pending). Reaction: :robot_face:

Sam B.: Adding smoke test to midnight run (00:50 UTC). I'll tail logs and trigger a manual abort if latency > 500ms for >2 consecutive minutes. Will ping @oncall if anything looks off.

Priya Nair: changelog draft posted: https://redwood.docs/changes/v3.8/draft — please review before 01:00 UTC.

Anika Rao: Pin done in staging: pin-id: pin-emb-3.8.2-Q-01. Staging smoke green. Will push to prod pin at 01:28 UTC and comment here.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Final checklist before freeze (quick):
- [x] Release notes reviewed (Priya)
- [x] Embedding pin in staging (Anika)
- [ ] Embedding pin in prod (Anika @01:28)
- [x] Smoke script in CI (Sam)
- [x] Rollback owner assigned (Josh)
- [x] Traffic drain plan (Leo)

Josh Klein: I'll be on standby at 02:00–02:40 UTC. If immediate rollback, I'll trigger rollback script and post status.

Anika Rao: Prod pin applied at 01:28 UTC: pin-id: pin-emb-3.8.2-Q-01. Prod smoke quick-pass. :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: Lovely. Deploy-bot, start freeze at 02:00 and lock config. After freeze, proceed with canary deploy at 02:05.

Deploy-bot: action: freeze_canary_config(v3.8) -> started at 02:00 UTC. Lock token set.

Leo Martins: Traffic drain started at 01:55 UTC -> canary weight 0.1.

Sam B.: Midnight smoke ran; quick metrics look ok. I'll watch the first 10 minutes post-canary and report.

Maya Patel: If anyone sees >5% error rate or latency regression >20%, hit rollback and ping #eng-oncall. Otherwise we'll keep canary for 45m then ramp. :rocket:

Josh Klein: Copy. On standby.

Sam B.: First 6m after canary deploy: errors stable, latency +8% peak. Monitoring continuing.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Will post final rollout decision at 02:50 UTC after the 45m observation window. :eyes:
